```yaml
name: Test Rust uprobe and bpftrace

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install bpftrace
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bpftrace

      - name: Build helloworld example (debug)
        run: |
          cargo build --manifest-path examples/rust/helloworld/Cargo.toml

      - name: Verify hello symbol in helloworld binary
        run: |
          nm -C target/debug/helloworld | grep -q 'helloworld::hello' || (echo "Symbol not found" && exit 1)

      - name: Run helloworld binary
        run: |
          output=$(./target/debug/helloworld)
          echo "$output"
          echo "$output" | grep -q 'Hello, world!' || (echo "Unexpected output" && exit 1)

      - name: Build args example (debug)
        run: |
          cargo build --manifest-path examples/rust/args/Cargo.toml

      - name: Verify hello symbol in args binary
        run: |
          nm -C target/debug/args | grep -q 'helloworld::hello' || (echo "Symbol not found" && exit 1)

      - name: Run args binary
        run: |
          output=$(./target/debug/args)
          echo "$output"
          echo "$output" | grep -q 'Hello, world!' || (echo "Unexpected output" && exit 1)

      - name: Test bpftrace attach to helloworld
        run: |
          BINARY=target/debug/helloworld
          # Start bpftrace in background
          bpftrace -e 'uprobe:$BINARY:_ZN10helloworld5hello* { printf("hello called\n"); }' > bpftrace.log 2>&1 &
          BPF_PID=$!
          # Give bpftrace a moment to attach
          sleep 1
          # Run the binary
          $BINARY
          # Wait a bit for the probe to fire
          sleep 1
          # Kill bpftrace
          kill $BPF_PID
          # Verify probe output
          grep -q "hello called" bpftrace.log || (echo "Probe did not fire" && exit 1)
```
